```swift let originalTexture = SKTexture(imageNamed: "sourceImage.png") let rect = CGRect(origin: originalTexture.textureRect().origin, size: CGSize(width: originalTexture.textureRect().midX, height: originalTexture.textureRect().midY)) let croppedTexture = SKTexture(rect: rect, in: originalTexture) ```

segments.contextAfter: In the above example, if `originalTexture` had a size of `(348.0, 282.0)` and a [`textureRect()`](sktexture/texturerect().md) of `{(0,0) (1,1)}`, `croppedTexture` will have a size of `(174.0, 141.0)` and a [`textureRect()`](sktexture/texturerect().md) of `{(0,0) (1,1)}`. `croppedTexture` will be a copy of the bottom left quadrant of `originalTexture`.
